description: This bar chart illustrates the effect of different language models on various linguistic tags. The horizontal axis represents the categories of linguistic tags – “case”, “gender”, “number”, and “tense” – listed in alphabetical order. The vertical axis, labeled “effect”, displays a linear scale ranging from -2 to 22, with tick labels at intervals of 5. For each tag, there are six bars representing different models: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (light grey), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (orange), and XLM-B₂ (red). Each bar includes error bars extending above and below the main bar. For the “case” tag, the bars range in height from approximately 3 for mBERT-R₂ to approximately 12 for XLM-B₂. For the “gender” tag, the bars range from approximately 1 for mBERT-L₂ to approximately 5 for XLM-B₂. For the “number” tag, the bars range from approximately 1 for XLM-L₂ to approximately 5 for mBERT-B₂. For the “tense” tag, the bars range from approximately -1 for mBERT-R₂ to approximately 2 for XLM-B₂. The bars are grouped by tag, with each model represented by a bar within each group. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
